verdict.rationale: Lowenstein documents an Employment practice that counsels startups on employment-law compliance and drafts HR policies and handbooks. Adjacent evidence includes trade-secret information-protection programs and Clerky post-incorporation setup capturing founder IP details. None of this specifically names the hiring paperwork in the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of drafting offer letters, employment agreements, and employee invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements, plus any independent corroboration.
